verification.originalFailure: The separate codec fixture wrote HTML into an ImageDocument and never created its native media element. Replaced only that synthetic document; genuine media endpoints and assertions unchanged.
verification.interpretation: 10 application/model cases and 1 native-codec case passed in separate runs on the same immutable production build; not one 11-case all-green run.

intelligence.interpretation: Runtime and application wiring only; no relevance or audio-classification accuracy score.

whistle.interpretation: Whole-track local inference and persistence only; no reference transcript or song accuracy score.

nativeCodecFallback.scope: Separate Chromium native-media integration; does not impersonate a Safari engine or replace app capability checks.

coverage.interpretation: The original private matrix remains conservatively all owned gaps because that original combined run contained a fixture failure. Focused assertions and the separate codec repair are reported above; no inventory row is silently promoted.

limits: Chromium desktop and mobile emulation only; no native Safari or Firefox verification.
No human song transcript labels; no WER/CER or transcription accuracy claim.
Metadata/lyrics embeddings are not audio classification or guaranteed recommendation relevance.
Real direct scanner import is covered; the complete queued worker is not.
Private media, transcripts, titles, covers, credentials, traces and detailed reports remain ignored.
